selection_method: Native Pexels actual MP4 download -> SHA256 -> ffprobe -> complete FFmpeg decode -> 15/50/85 percent source frames + left/center/right 50 percent cropped samples -> vision-based editorial review of derived stills only, not full playback

decisions.rationale: Frame samples show frontal recognisable actor reading through a window with an open book and very little sampled motion; lacks back-facing anonymous charcoal-jacket subject, visible rain and CLOSED notebook
Frame samples show suitable back-facing seated dark-clad adult at wood desk with lamp and physical motion, but no visible rain window; small closed notebook is not proven and crop may lose subject
Frame samples show front/side-facing identifiable actor in light short-sleeved shirt under strong yellow light, without a window, rain, closed notebook or matching ROOM_A continuity

recommendation: Retain Pexels 32788087 only as a non-media photographic composition reference of back-facing protagonist. Do not splice any tested MP4 into the S01 video. Obtain a wholly coherent long-take with rain window plus closed notebook before full editorial and rights review.
